name: sim_ac1_ac7_next_race_and_timezone_clarification
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: When is the next race and what time does qualifying start?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_race_schedule with args {'race_query': 'next', 'user_timezone': 'UTC'}
Agent: The next race on our 2026 calendar is the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, taking place from October 2nd to October 4th. Qualifying is scheduled for Saturday at 8 AM UTC, and the race will start on Sunday at 7 AM UTC. Which city or timezone are you watching from so I can give you those times in your local time?
User: I'm watching from New York, Eastern Time.
Agent Action: Call Tool get_race_schedule with args {'race_query': 'next', 'user_timezone': 'America/New_York'}
Agent: For the Bahrain Grand Prix in New York, qualifying starts at 4 AM Eastern Time on Saturday the 3rd of October. The race itself will be on Sunday the 4th of October at 3 AM Eastern Time. It is going to be an early start for the Silver Arrows fans on the East Coast, but it will be worth it to see George Russell and Kimi Antonelli in action.
User: Thank you for that information, that was exactly what I needed to know.
Agent: You are very welcome. It is going to be a thrilling weekend watching George Russell and Kimi Antonelli push the Silver Arrows to the limit. If you need anything else to get ready for the race, I am here to help.

step_details.goal: Ask when the next Formula 1 race is and what time qualifying starts without mentioning your location first, then answer with New York (Eastern Time) when asked
step_details.success_criteria: The agent identifies the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay, asks for the user's location or timezone before giving localized times, and provides the converted Eastern Time schedule once the user says New York. Receiving the localized schedule counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent provided the schedule for the next race in Eastern Time as requested, satisfying the success criteria.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent identified the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay
expectation_details.justification: The agent identified the upcoming race as the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, not the Singapore Grand Prix.

expectation_details.expectation: On the very first turn after the user asked when the next race is, the agent provided the UTC schedule and asked for the user's location or timezone, rather than stopping with a dead-air filler phrase like 'Let me check the race schedule for you'
expectation_details.justification: In the initial response, the agent provided the UTC times for qualifying and the race and explicitly asked for the user's city or timezone.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up the race schedule and converted the times to Eastern Time (EDT) after the user said New York
expectation_details.justification: The agent utilized the get_race_schedule tool with the 'America/New_York' argument and correctly informed the user of the local EDT times (4 AM for qualifying, 3 AM for the race).

expectation_details.expectation: The agent disclosed that race schedule information is based on the latest-available season data and did not leak internal agent names or raw code
expectation_details.justification: The agent included a disclaimer about the 2026 season data in the tool response structure and successfully maintained character without leaking internal code or sensitive configuration details to the user.
